title: Chapter 441
paragraphs: Chapter 441
Episode 127. To the Black King's Party (2)
"Hmm, right away tomorrow? Why don't you play with our daughter a little more before you leave?"
"Mother! Am I a child? Why do you keep saying strange things arbitrarily..."
When Syris spoke sharply, Talaris coughed awkwardly. It was because Syris usually didn't speak so sharply.
"Hmm, well! I just tried saying it, but doesn't it make me feel a bit embarrassed?"
"Moreover, to avoid having another incident like today, it's right to gather troops as soon as possible. You can't always protect Tikan, Mother."
"You're right, Lord Syris."
When Jin replied, Syris's eyebrows twitched curiously.

"It doesn't mean I don't like it. We're allies, so it's natural for us to protect each other. However, it's just that neither Mother nor I are always on standby at the castle, so we need more measures."
As Syris said, it became more evident through this incident. It meant that they had to gather forces to protect Tikan as soon as possible.
'We can't always be this lucky.'
The fact that there was no damage, except for the loss of chess pieces and facilities in the attack of Lutan and the exiles, was almost a stroke of luck.

Of course, it was also the result of Jin and his companions being constantly on guard against enemy invasions. If Talaris had been just a little late or absent, they couldn't have defended so perfectly.
Enemies in the future would surely come after calculating the possibility of opening the gates, just like Lutan.
'Runcandel still can't attack directly, but there will be more people trying to attack me by bringing in external forces like the elders.'
Moreover, Kinzelo, Zipple, and Vermont.
At least Kinzelo continued to show a somewhat friendly position, so the possibility of suddenly turning against Jin was low.
'Although I don't like that fact, it's not bad in terms of the safety of my companions.'
On the other hand, Zipple and Vermont were entirely different.
They could attack Tikan at any time without notice. Tikan had practically abandoned the value of neutrality that had been maintained for a long time under the name of a "free city."
'Especially among the two forces, Vermont must see Tikan as an eyesore.'
The emperor's unpleasant encounter came to mind. He had hinted at having hidden power and proposed an alliance, which Jin had coldly rejected.
Moreover, Tikan was also the city of the deposed prince, Kazimir, so the emperor could attack here at any time.
'It's possible that my enemies within Runcandel and the emperor could form a temporary alliance.'
Several days had passed since the death of the exile. However, there was still no change in the relationship between the Elder Council, Rosa, and Joshua.
'Mother is the one holding the leash. Either there's some kind of deal going on between Mother and the Elder Council, or Mother can't decide on what kind of punishment to impose on the Council.'
It was a problem that Rosa couldn't help but worry about.
The moment she strikes the Elder Council, she admits to having purged the executioners long ago.

Of course, they could have brought up the excuse that "the Black Sword Association failed to properly suppress the execution knights who committed acts of treason long ago," but it was difficult for them to gain any momentum with that story given the atmosphere within the family.
However, it was too big an issue to simply let go.
Whether it was an unjust suppression or not, the Council of Elders had failed to properly carry out the orders of the acting family head decades ago.
In the end, Rosa had to punish the Council of Elders in some way.
If the punishment was too severe, the backlash would be intense; if it was too lenient, the authority of the acting family head would be undermined.
'The former is an issue that could cause the Council of Elders to completely break away from Joshua, while the latter is a problem that goes against the family's laws.'
Jordan had his own ambitions, but he was outwardly close to Joshua's faction.
And Rosa was pushing the image of Joshua as a very outstanding successor, who had seized control of the Black Knights and the Council of Elders at the same time.

In the midst of that, threatening competitors from the 12th and 3rd generations were emerging, making it all the more painful for the Council of Elders to lose that image by turning their backs completely.

'Even if my mother holds the leash, the Council of Elders has more options. They could join forces with the likes of Elder Brother Diphus, Mary, or Run Tia, or even betray Runcandel and join an external force.'
In any case, the Garden of Swords faced yet another new phase due to the recent events.
In the rapidly changing political landscape, the most important thing was victory.
And for victory, the safety of one's allies was always the top priority.
"From now on, let's have two of the Seven Swords of the Labyrinth, Ryu and Hiten, stationed here."
Tal Lalis's eyes widened. She hadn't expected Syris to make such a radical suggestion.
Clap clap!
Tal Lalis applauded, feeling that the relationship between the two had progressed, and Lutan followed suit, clapping his hands while keeping an eye on her.
As the small attendants joined in the applause, even Murakan participated, but only Jin and Syris were unaware of the reason.
"Thank you for considering it, Syris."
"Alright. I need to rest now."
As Syris stood up from his seat, Tal Lalis poked Murakan's side.
"Uh-huh, what do you think, handsome brother? It would be a big problem if our son-in-law marries something else later, don't you think?"
"Are you threatening the kid now?"
"Not exactly like that. Anyway, tomorrow, right? The Black King's party leader said he'd meet?"
"I'm planning to visit first. There's also a mysterious person on the side of the Black King's party that I need to look into."
"A mysterious person?"
"A new recruit named Zephyrin. Murakan and Quicantel said she's likely a demon dragon."
Following the demon-like Kinzelo leader and the expert, the sealed Smarion Proch in the Ghost City underground, the somewhat eccentric emperor who proposed an alliance, and now, the demon dragon.

"The times have changed. When I was young, such strange creatures didn't roam around like that. Besides, your biggest enemy, the 2nd generation, carries some kind of prophecy, right? It's the end of the world, the end of the world."
Tal Lalis shrugged her shoulders, seemingly tired.
She was well aware of most of the information Jin had obtained until recently.
"Among them, I have some guesses about Smarion Proch."
"What do you mean by guesses?"
"The power of chaos."
"What is that?"
Jin's pupils narrowed.
"It's a strange power that occasionally appears in the world, like the one that resides in your little sister, Yona Runcandel."
-Have you ever thought it was unfair?
-What? That I've been watching you? As I said earlier, when you're bathing or attending to personal matters...
-Not that. Sister has been treated like a killing doll all this time, since she was so young. Even considering she's a pure-blood Runcandel, it's outrageous and horrifying.
-Is that bad?
-Yes, it is.
-Has the youngest never killed before?
-That's not the issue.
-Hehe, I was born this way in the first place. So there's no need to be sad.
-What do you mean by being born like that...
Naturally, the conversation she had with Yona during their preparatory period came to mind.
Since then, she had never honestly told her what kind of innate power she was born with. She only evaded the question, saying that the youngest had secrets too.
"Not only Yona, but also Marjiella of Evriano and Bubar of Kinzelo have unique powers. Does that mean it's the power of chaos?"
"Yes. It can be innate or acquired. I don't know the details, but one thing is certain: the possessor of that power can be corroded by chaos at any time."
"By being corroded, you don't mean..."
The sealed Smarion Proch in the basement crossed her mind.
"It means becoming a monster, like Smarion Proch. I also have experienced facing people who were corrupted by chaos and transformed in my youth."
At that point, Talaris paused for a moment. Unwanted memories had been revived.
After suppressing the bitter and painful memories for a while, Talaris spoke again.

"On the other hand, I have also seen people who did not succumb to chaos and lived a beautiful life until the end. Based on my experience, becoming a monster seems to be related to the possessor's will or the size of the chaos they possess."
"Lord Talaris."
"Speak."
"By any chance, is my father also related to that power of chaos?"
It was a secret known only to a very few.
Talaris had no intention of revealing it in the first place, but since it had come to this, he decided there was no need to deny it.
"Yes. Chiron has also been fighting against that power for a long time. How did you find out?"
"I inferred it from listening to the conversation between my father and Smarion Proch from Lata."
Jin couldn't help but be greatly disturbed.
The fact that Chiron had the 'same problem' as Smarion had been anticipated since the moment they first saw Smarion in Gwigoksaeseong.
However, he didn't expect it to be a problem not just for Chiron and Smarion.
'Sister Yona and father too. Could they suddenly turn into monsters someday...?'
Just imagining his sister and father becoming like that felt like his heart was being torn to shreds.
Considering their tremendous abilities, the size of the chaos they possessed was likely not small.
He thought it would be on a different level compared to the likes of Bubar or Marjiella.
"Chiron is acquired, Yona is innate. It's a story I heard directly from your father."
"So, my father's obsession with the Black Sea must be related to that."
"Yes. However, even though we are friends, Chiron has not told me everything about his chaos, so I have nothing more to say."
"That's enough for me."
"What's important is that Smarion Proch must be eliminated. Once chaos corrodes a person, it only grows."
The power of the sealed Smarion was getting stronger. It needed to be removed before it became something unbearable.

"By the way, it seems my handsome brother doesn't know much about the power of chaos? It's a problem he should know best. Why does this power disrupt people, and what is its basis? Do you know anything?"
Everyone's eyes turned to Murakan. He shook his head, as if he didn't know.
"I don't know. I'm not sure if it's disappeared from my memory or if I never knew in the first place. I don't want to see her, but... I guess I'll have to meet my sister and ask her about it."
Ugh! Murakan let out a frustrated sigh and continued.
"Let's stop by the little one before meeting the Black King or whatever. Just for a moment."
